post.originalText:
RIP motion designers. Absolutely blown away by the visual and sound design from Opus 5.5.

Experimenting with potential launch videos for @getrenapp with one-shot prompts using Opus 5.5.

Prompt:

"[gave access to Ren repo] Make a dynamic 30-second motion graphics video for Ren that shows off your motion and sound design. Go crazy."

After each video I told it to one-up the previous one with its capabilities. Here are the results:
